signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend or discontinue the Website or Services, temporarily or permanently, with or without notice, subject to its governing agreements and law.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Additional client portals are available as paid add-ons.
While Free and Standard plans come with a fixed number of members, you can still add more to Essentials and Advanced plans.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 8 reviews (1.3% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: when you schedule a meeting with the founder, he never shows up
nobody from FuseBase showed up or communicated why they didn't show up

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 3.2 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $468 regular price (83% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend or discontinue the Website or Services, temporarily or permanently, with or without notice, subject to its governing agreements and law.
The Company may change this Agreement at its discretion, subject to the governing agreement and mandatory law.

trials.claim: Each additional code beyond code 10 unlocks 3 members, 3 guests, 100GB storage and 1500 OCR records
trials.claimQuote: Each additional code stacked beyond code 10 unlocks: 3 members, 3 guests, 100 GB storage, and 1,500 OCR records
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict the per-code increases.

trials.claim: Previous customers will retain their previous user and teammate limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will retain their previous user and teammate limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about previous customers retaining their limits.

trials.claim: Deal includes all future Solo, Essentials or Advanced plan updates by code tier
trials.claimQuote: All future Solo (Codes 1-2), Essentials (Codes 3-9) or Advanced (Codes 10+) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit is a generic right to modify or discontinue services subject to governing agreements, which does not specifically contradict the deal's future-updates promise, and no exhibit confirms it.

exhibits.quote: The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend or discontinue the Website or Services, temporarily or permanently, with or without notice, subject to its governing agreements and law.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to modify or discontinue services, which undermines promise of all future plan updates.

trials.claim: FuseBase provides a secure AI-powered workspace to unite team, clients and partners and keep projects running 24/7
trials.claimQuote: FuseBase offers a secure, AI-powered workspace to unite your team, clients, and partners, and keep projects running smoothly 24/7.
trials.reasoning: Buyers directly report the product is very insecure for confidential documents and is extremely slow and freezes, materially undercutting the secure, always-running workspace claim despite the listed security features.

exhibits.quote: 1. Very insecure. I would not put any confidential documentation on this app. (Anyone can resuse the same browser session and steal important information)
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product is very insecure, contradicting secure workspace claim.

exhibits.quote: Not to mention when the time came to actually use the tool, it was extremely slow and freezes all the time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports tool was extremely slow and freezes, contradicting keep projects running 24/7 claim.

exhibits.quote: SSO, 2FA, and encryption keep your data protected, always.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms FuseBase provides security protections for user data.

exhibits.quote: Thanks to dedicated customer portals, I now have a centralized hub to access everything I need in one place—from project schedules, documents, and conversations to related tasks.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms FuseBase provides a centralized hub that unites work, documents and collaboration.

trials.claim: Buyers can build their own WorkOS to streamline collaboration with AI coding, agents and new portals
trials.claimQuote: Build your own WorkOS to streamline team and client collaboration with AI coding, agents, and new portals
trials.reasoning: Detailed buyer reports confirm AI agents building and deploying features and rebuilding an app with client portals, directly showing the claimed WorkOS building capability works.

exhibits.quote: Connections don't work as expected (rather connecting via MCP from Claude to the platform or connecting via MCP from agents within the platform).
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports connections and agent connections do not work as expected, undermining streamline collaboration claim.

exhibits.quote: So called "AI agents" that didn't know anything about anything, to app making tool which didn't make any sense at all.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports AI agents knew nothing and app-making tool made no sense, contradicting WorkOS streamlining claim.

exhibits.quote: You describe a feature in plain English, an AI agent builds it on top of your FuseBase databases, and you test it locally and deploy it.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms AI agents can build and deploy features on FuseBase databases.

exhibits.quote: I just rebuilt an app I had on Frontly using client portals in the latest format (Astro), without using Google Sheets.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms building a custom app with client portals on FuseBase works.

trials.claim: Users can use AI tools and editors like ChatGPT, Claude and VS Code to build custom apps extending FuseBase
trials.claimQuote: Use AI tools and editors (ChatGPT, Claude, VS Code, etc.) to build custom apps that extend FuseBase
trials.reasoning: The vendor states users can use their Claude Code and ChatGPT subscriptions to create apps, and a buyer confirms connecting Claude to create builds; reliance on users' own AI accounts is the stated model, not a contradiction.

exhibits.quote: Such features may rely on third-party AI providers, third-party infrastructure, customer-selected providers, customer-managed accounts, customer-provided API keys, or a combination of these.
exhibits.argument: Vendor requires customer-managed accounts and API keys for AI features, limiting built-in use of external AI tools.

exhibits.quote: So I'm now $700 plus into this. And the first time I tried level 10, I spent 15 or 20 minutes with the worker and racked up $83 in charges to my AA account to do what I considered very little work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer incurred $83 in extra AI charges for very little work, undermining ease of using AI tools to build apps.

exhibits.quote: FuseBase doesn't charge you for API tokens; you can use your Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc., subscriptions to create apps, which is significantly less expensive than using solutions that charge you for token usage.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states users can use Claude Code and ChatGPT subscriptions to create apps.

exhibits.quote: I connected Claude, tell it what I need, agree to the plan, and it goes ahead and creates it.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms using Claude to create builds on FuseBase works as described.

themes.summary: Many buyers say scheduled demos and support calls get cancelled or no-showed with no reply.
